node.title: Re^3: Issues with Net::SCP::Expect
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If you don't mind you probably should just use the build in /usr/bin/scp, it's better than every perl module I've tried and just works.

Really, even better than [mod://Net::OpenSSH]? Scripting an external binary is a tricky and brittle thing to do (see e.g. [id://1180578|here]), and not something I'd recommend if there's a module that already does the task well, otherwise one is just reinventing the wheel.
